description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join JPMorganChase and discover a career where your skills and ideas truly make a difference. You'll help shape the future of data management by supporting client onboarding and collaborating with teams across the organization. Your attention to detail and commitment to excellence will ensure we meet regulatory standards and deliver outstanding client experiences. The position offers opportunities to innovate and contribute to process improvements.
  

  

As a Client Data Associate I in Operations, you will manage and verify client information to support KYC and AML compliance. You'll use digital platforms to optimize workflows, resolve service issues, and maintain the integrity of confidential data. Engaging with stakeholders, you'll facilitate discussions that drive positive outcomes and operational efficiency. This role is ideal for those interested in financial services and data operations, offering growth in a fast\-paced environment, and where your expertise will help support the firm's regulatory requirements.
  

  

**Job responsibilities*** Manage and verify client data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with KYC and AML standards.
* Support seamless client onboarding processes, proactively resolving service issues to deliver outstanding client experiences.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to track exceptions, facilitate discussions, and achieve timely completion of KYC processes.
* Utilize digital platforms and analytical tools to process, analyze, and enhance client data management across products and platforms.
* Identify and implement process improvements to drive operational efficiency and support continuous improvement initiatives.
**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Advanced analytical and research skills, with proficiency in digital tools and Microsoft Office Suite for data management and reporting.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management abilities, with a client\-focused approach.
* In\-depth knowledge of KYC/AML policies and experience supporting regulatory compliance and client onboarding.
* Proven track record of driving operational efficiency and contributing to process improvement initiatives.
**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Experience in AML, Compliance, Fraud, KYC, or Operational Risk within financial services.
* Ability to drive data\-driven initiatives and foster collaboration among stakeholders, utilizing influence and project management skills.
* Expertise in leveraging AI, machine learning, and process automation to enhance data analysis and streamline workflows.
* Strong adaptability and resilience in dynamic, high\-pressure environments, with interpersonal skills to motivate teams and negotiate effective solutions.
* Advanced proficiency in developing quantitative reports and actionable insights to support strategic decision\-making and continuous improvement.
**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  

  

J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

description:
**Company Description** **CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

 **Job Description**  

Mattel is seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented **Workday HRIS Consultant** with expertise in **Workday HCM, Compensation, and Security** to support the design, configuration, enhancement, and ongoing administration of our global Workday platform. This role will partner closely with HR, Total Rewards, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that improve employee experience, ensure data integrity, and support organizational growth.


The ideal candidate will possess strong Workday functional expertise, problem\-solving skills, and a passion for optimizing HR technology through continuous improvement and innovation.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Workday Configuration \& Administration**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday HCM, Compensation, and Security modules.
* Design and implement business process changes, condition rules, calculated fields, notifications, and security configurations.
* Support Workday releases, perform impact analysis, regression testing, and feature adoption.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions aligned with best practices.

**Compensation Management**

* Support annual compensation planning cycles, merit processes, bonus programs, and compensation reviews.
* Configure compensation eligibility rules, compensation grades, plans, and related business processes.
* Partner with Total Rewards teams to implement compensation\-related enhancements and process improvements.
* Troubleshoot compensation\-related issues and provide timely resolutions.

**Security Administration**

* Configure and maintain domain and business process security policies.
* Manage role\-based security assignments and perform periodic security audits.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements.
* Support security reviews, segregation\-of\-duty controls, and risk mitigation initiatives.

**Reporting \& Data Management**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance Workday reports, dashboards, and calculated fields.
* Ensure HR data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across Workday modules.
* Analyze workforce and compensation data to support business decision\-making.
* Support internal and external audit requests through accurate reporting and documentation.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with HR, Payroll, Compensation, Talent, and IT teams to identify system enhancement opportunities.
* Provide functional guidance and recommendations based on Workday best practices.
* Support global HR initiatives, system implementations, and organizational changes.
* Deliver end\-user support and training for Workday processes and functionality.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes through automation and system enhancements.
* Stay current with Workday releases and emerging HR technology trends.
* Participate in HR transformation and digitalization initiatives.

 **Qualifications** **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 3\-7 years of hands\-on experience supporting Workday HCM implementations and production support environments.
* Proven experience configuring and administering:
	+ Workday Core HCM
	+ Workday Compensation
	+ Workday Security
* Experience supporting global HR operations and complex organizational structures.
* Experience with Workday business processes, condition rules, calculated fields, and security frameworks.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of Workday security architecture, domains, business process security, and role assignments.
* Experience supporting merit, bonus, and compensation review cycles within Workday.
* Advanced reporting expertise using Workday Report Writer and calculated fields.
* Experience with EIBs, data loads, and mass data updates.
* Strong Excel skills including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data analysis techniques.
* Exposure to HR technology automation and AI\-enabled solutions.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high\-quality solutions.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Pro or Workday Certification in HCM, Compensation, or Security.
* Experience supporting annual compensation planning cycles.
* Exposure to Workday Prism Analytics or People Analytics.
* Experience working in consumer products, retail, manufacturing, or global enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with Workday integrations, Studio, Core Connectors, and Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB).
* Knowledge of Agile project methodologies.
* Experience participating in Workday implementations, enhancement projects, or HR transformation initiatives.

 **Additional Information**  

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.  

  

**How We Work:**  

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**  

We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

**Who We Are:**  

Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.


Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.


Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.  

  

Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment.

The Principal Engineer, Identity \& Access Management (IAM) is responsible for the design, development, implementation, and optimization of SailPoint IdentityIQ/Identity Security solutions across the enterprise. This role serves as a technical leader for IAM initiatives, partnering with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, and governance teams to deliver scalable identity governance and access management capabilities while ensuring compliance and security standards.


**Essential Functions**
-----------------------


### **Technical Leadership**


* Lead architecture reviews, solution design, and technical planning for SailPoint IdentityIQ initiatives.
* Define IAM engineering standards, best practices, and governance controls.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and developers.

### **SailPoint Engineering \& Development**


* Design, develop, and maintain SailPoint IdentityIQ solutions.
* Build and support custom connectors, workflows, rules, and integrations using Java, BeanShell, REST APIs, and SailPoint frameworks.

### **Identity Governance**


* Implement and enhance role\-based access control (RBAC).

### **Platform Operations**


* Lead platform upgrades, performance tuning, and capacity planning activities.
* Troubleshoot complex provisioning, aggregation, and connector\-related issues.
* Ensure platform availability, stability, and operational excellence.

---------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.

	+ SailPoint IdentityIQ Architecture
	+ Java and BeanShell Development
	+ REST APIs and Web Services
	+ Active Directory / LDAP
	+ SQL and Database Integrations
	+ Access Certifications and Role Management
	+ RBAC and SoD Controls
	+ ServiceNow Integrations
* Experience leading technical designs and enterprise\-scale IAM implementations.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Healthcare industry experience.
* Experience with CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Entra ID, Okta, or other IAM/PAM technologies.
* Cloud IAM experience (Azure/AWS/GCP).
* CISSP, SailPoint Certified Engineer, Security\+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience supporting audit and regulatory requirements.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
----------------------------------


* Deep understanding of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Experience driving strategic IAM roadmaps and modernization initiatives.
* Ability to lead cross\-functional technical teams and influence architecture decisions.

* Architecture and design authority.
* Mentoring and capability development.

**Cyber Security Analyst**
==========================

**Location:** Hyderabad, India **Work Arrangement:** On\-Site**About the Role**
------------------


As a **Cyber Security Analyst** at Hyland, you will play a critical role in protecting enterprise systems by monitoring, detecting, investigating, and responding to cybersecurity threats across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will work with modern security technologies, AI\-driven security capabilities, automation platforms, and advanced threat detection solutions to strengthen the organization's overall security posture. This role is ideal for a passionate, detail\-oriented security professional who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment and is eager to grow alongside an experienced global cybersecurity team.**Your Role Responsibilities – Here's What You'll Do**
------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor and investigate security alerts, suspicious activities, and threats across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid enterprise environments; respond to and manage security incidents following established Incident Response (IR) procedures
* Perform threat hunting, log analysis, and security investigations using industry\-standard security tools; leverage AI\-powered security technologies to identify anomalies, emerging threats, and operational risks
* Support and administer security technologies including SIEM platforms (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar), EDR/XDR Platforms, Security Monitoring Tools, Security Posture Management Solutions, and Threat Intelligence Platforms
* Assist in developing and improving detection use cases, response playbooks, automation workflows, and security documentation to strengthen the organization's overall security posture
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, engineering, and business teams to improve security controls and processes; evaluate emerging security and AI technologies and provide recommendations to enhance security capabilities
* Communicate security findings and recommendations effectively to stakeholders; contribute to a proactive, security\-first culture through continuous learning and knowledge sharing

**Role Essentials – What You'll Need**
--------------------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience; **minimum 4\+ years of experience** in Security Operations Center (SOC), Incident Response, Cyber Security Operations, or Threat Analysis
* Knowledge of **cybersecurity fundamentals, networking concepts**, and security best practices; experience supporting Windows and Linux/Unix environments
* Hands\-on experience with **one or more SIEM platforms** (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar)
* Strong **analytical and problem\-solving skills** with an investigative mindset; effective written and verbal communication skills
* Familiarity with the **MITRE ATT\&CK Framework**; ability to detect, analyze, and respond to cybersecurity threats across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments

**What We'd Like to See – Preferred Skills**
--------------------------------------------

* Experience in **Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering**, and Security Automation \& Orchestration (SOAR)
* Hands\-on experience with **AI\-assisted security operations** and AI\-driven detection capabilities
* Experience with **EDR/XDR technologies, Threat Intelligence platforms**, and Cloud Security (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Proficiency in **automation and scripting** using Python, PowerShell, or APIs; experience with Detection Use Case Development \& Tuning
* Preferred certifications: **CompTIA Security\+/CySA\+/CASP\+, Microsoft SC\-200/AZ\-500, CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CEH, Splunk Certifications**, or GIAC/SANS certifications (GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GCDA)
